name: io.github.anipotts/imessage-mcp
title: iMessage History
description: Read-only MCP server for searching and reading Apple Messages history on macOS.

environmentVariables.name: IMESSAGE_PRIVACY
environmentVariables.description: Most any caller can see: full (default for stdio), redacted, or aggregate.

environmentVariables.name: IMESSAGE_CONTACTS
environmentVariables.description: live (default) names handles from Contacts; none shows handles only.

environmentVariables.name: IMESSAGE_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to a copy of chat.db instead of this Mac's Messages database.

environmentVariables.name: IMESSAGE_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to keep the search index in memory only.

environmentVariables.name: IMESSAGE_UPDATE_CHECK
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to turn off the npm version check.
